subject: Conditional reactivation request — Datumlytics sandbox & credits
messages:
From: Krista Lewis <krista@datumlytics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: re-enable trial sandbox for Datumlytics

Hi Kimberly,

Hope you're well. We ran a short pilot with Redwood in June but the sandbox expired while our procurement team was finalizing a PO (internal delays). The team is ready to pick the evaluation back up — primarily to finish latency/regression tests and a short production smoke test for our search assistant — but we no longer have credits or an active sandbox.

Would you be able to temporarily re-enable our sandbox and add a small top-up of promo credits so we can complete verification? We used about 32k tokens during the initial run; a 25k–30k token extension would let us validate the edge cases we still need to cover. Our procurement lead (procurement@datumlytics.com) is aiming to get a PO over to you by Sep 10 but asked if Redwood could provide a short runway.

I've attached a quick usage snapshot and our SOC2 summary for reference. If you need anything from procurement to expedite, let me know — I can loop them in.

Thanks,
Krista Lewis
Head of Product
Datumlytics

Attachments: trial-usage-report.csv (CSV, 12KB), SOC2-overview.pdf (PDF, 450KB)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Krista Lewis <krista@datumlytics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: re-enable trial sandbox for Datumlytics

Hi Krista — great to hear from you and glad the team is ready again.

Short answer: we can do a conditional reactivation to keep momentum while procurement closes. Proposed terms below so we have clarity on scope and next steps: 

- Provisioning: temporary sandbox re-enabled within 24 hours once we receive internal approval.
- Credit top-up: 20,000 free tokens granted as a one-time promotional allocation (usable for 30 days).
- Usage cap: sandbox will be limited to your evaluation projects (we'll enforce project IDs).
- Procurement commitment: we ask for a PO or written procurement timeline by Sep 15; if we don't receive this, the sandbox/credits will be paused and any extra usage billed at standard trial rates.
- MAP: please provide a 1-page mutual action plan (MAP) summarizing the validation objectives and milestone dates — this helps our Customer Success team coordinate.

If that works, say so and we'll flip the switch and send over the authorization ID. If you need a larger top-up, I can escalate for manager approval but we'd need the MAP and a firm PO date first.

Next steps: reply with confirmation and your preferred project name + the MAP; Monica will share onboarding details and a short checklist.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Thanks, Kimberly — that sounds good and we appreciate the runway. We confirm the MAP and timelines:

- Objective: complete latency/regression tests and a 2-day smoke test for search assistant in staging.
- Milestones: MAP submitted by Aug 31; testing window Sep 1–Sep 7; procurement to send PO by Sep 10 (hard target).
- Project name: datumlytics-prod-eval

Attached is the PO stub (datumlytics-po-0810.pdf) our procurement team will convert to a formal PO; Ian is copied here and will follow up. Please proceed with the 20k credit and sandbox reactivation.

Appreciate the flexibility — we'll keep you posted.

Best,
